title: Enceladus sprays ice into space
description:
Astronomers say the plumes of Enceladus likely link to an ocean under its ice shell. Cassini found them in 2005.
NASA picture of the day, 5 Nov 2026. Credit: Cassini Imaging Team, SSI, JPL, ESA, NASA
